name: stunning-bars-l5-five
note: PO #26 kept ("show health bar for the 5 survivors, so the player knows how they are"): the five L5 followers are a small group, so all of them carry bars, healthy ones too; only groups larger than five hide healthy bars (QA #37). All five are healthy, so any bar proves the small-group rule; at zoom 0.5 the group is wider than the frame (5 bars at zoom 1 and 1.5).
